text: In the laying hen, only the left ovary and oviduct are functional. The ovary is a cluster of developing yolks. The oviduct is divided into 4 parts: the first part (infundibulum) is where the yolk is released; the second part (magnum) is where the egg white is added; the third and fourth parts (uterus) are where the shell is produced. The vagina is made of muscle and helps push the egg out.
